directDatabaseEvidence.method: Retained canonical database encrypted by the bounded Rust owner using OpenSSL CMS AES-256-GCM/RSA-OAEP-SHA256 for a temporary public recipient, then privately decrypted with the operator-held key. The ciphertext matches the manifest, and the plaintext's SHA-256 and size equal the manifest and the scanned file in the authenticated secret-paths.json. No database replay.
directDatabaseEvidence.scannerArguments: the image tier's secret_arguments(): dir, --redact=100, default config, empty ignore file, --ignore-gitleaks-allow, --max-decode-depth=3, --max-target-megabytes=0

trigger.description: The rebuilt dnf-upgrade layer moved libnghttp3 to 1.19.0-1.fc44 and tpm2-tss to 4.1.6-1.fc44, and the new package set reshaped the rpm Basenames index again: seven new complete regions appear, three of the nine database regions reviewed on 2026-11-11 recur and the other six do not occur. The four reviewed tpm2-tss and magic.mgc regions recur in byte-identical files, and the 15 reviewed base-layer (000/) regions recur and remain waived.

limits: The full canonical image archive was not retained. The database bytes come from the run's encrypted diagnostic and equal the scanned file by SHA-256 and size; the other three layer-001 files are byte-identical to the files of the 2026-11-11 evidence, so their canonical spans are carried over unchanged.
The 2026-11-24 canonical database was examined directly: no replay was built, and the pinned scanner over its projection reproduced exactly the run's ten database findings at the same coordinates.

A freeblock's content is the remainder of a deleted index record: its key and integer rowid bytes after the four header bytes the freeblock overwrote. Each such remainder equals the key and rowid of one live row of the immutable base database, a fedora-gpg-keys 44-1 file, and its key is a complete live key of the current database. Where the detector's candidate extends past a filename, the extra bytes are that record's rowid.

The live /usr/share/pki/rpm-gpg/ records of fedora-gpg-keys 44-2 in the three two-record regions have no full-path counterpart in the base, whose 44-1 ships these key files only under /etc/pki/rpm-gpg/; their filenames are live there.
Only hashes, coordinates and structural metadata are retained publicly. Candidate values, filenames and raw scanner matches remain private.
Every finding outside these exact complete regions remains blocking. Owner swiftraccoon and expiry 2027-02-20; no path, package or rule exemption and no expiry renewal.
The observed image scan failed. A fresh canonical image gate is required before signing or deployment, and the Fedora repositories may move again before that build.
